name: Rukkhashava Mushrooms
description: Before Where the Boat of Consciousness Lies A fungus that grows in layers upon layers, like a sea of clouds, and which mostly grows on trees deep in the rainforest. Therefore, they are considered by the people of Sumeru to be the holy crystallization of Rukkhadevata's legacy.
